name: AI asked for an implementation, user only described it verbally

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Could you implement a function that reverses a linked list?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I would walk through the list and reverse the pointers as I go. I'd keep track of previous, current, and next nodes. Time complexity is O(n) and space is O(1).

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Great, what about edge cases like empty list or single node?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Empty: return null. Single node: return as is. Both handled by the loop terminating immediately.
